units.source_text: 刚要走出伞铺，不知怎的，道子飞红了脸，独自匆匆地打车间的工匠面前走过，跑到马路上等候我们了。

en.t: Just as we were about to leave the umbrella shop, for some reason Michiko blushed bright red, hurried past the craftsmen in the workshop by herself, and ran out to the road to wait for us.

units.source_text: 许多工匠站在对面一排伞铺车间的格子窗边，眺望着我们。

en.t: Many craftsmen stood by the lattice windows of the row of umbrella workshops across the way, gazing at us.

units.source_text: 朝仓用半开半合的雨伞挡住自己的脸，急步走了过去。

en.t: Asakura hid his face behind a half-open umbrella and walked quickly past.

units.source_text: 我心想，他们在看什么呢？

en.t: I wondered to myself what they were looking at.

units.source_text: 道子同我保持一定距离，我走近她身边说：

en.t: Michiko kept a certain distance from me, so I went up beside her and said:
